name: bromfenac
uses: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE Bromfenac Ophthalmic Solution, 0.07% is indicated for the treatment of postoperative inflammation and reduction of ocular pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery. Bromfenac Ophthalmic Solution, 0.07% is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) indicated for the treatment of postoperative inflammation and reduction of ocular pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery. pediatric: 8.4 Pediatric Use The safety and effectiveness of bromfenac ophthalmic solution, 0.07% have not been established in pediatric patients.
